quotes.text: You built the vector database, you ingested the documents, you spent the budget, and yet, the hallucinations haven't stopped. In reality, mathematical similarity is not the same thing as business relevance.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Captures the core thesis that similarity does not equal relevance.

quotes.text: Vector search is excellent at finding the needle in the haystack if you don't care which needle you get. But in the enterprise, there is only one correct needle. The other nine are liabilities.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A memorable image for why precision matters in enterprise retrieval.

quotes.text: We have an accuracy crisis. And it's not an LLM problem. You can't fix this by switching from GPT-4 to GPT-5 or moving to a larger context window. It's a retrieval engineering problem.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes Copilot accuracy as a retrieval design issue rather than a model issue.

quotes.text: We need to start obsessing over the order in which that information is presented because the order of information is more important than the amount of information.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: States the case for reranking as the key architectural change.

quotes.text: The goal isn't to build the most accurate system possible. The goal is to build the most accurate system that the business can actually afford to run.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Balances accuracy ambitions against infrastructure cost.

chapters.title: The myth of pure vector search
Hybrid search: why BM25 still matters
Semantic ranking as the final filter

takeaways: Pure vector search confuses similarity with relevance, so combine it with BM25 keyword matching in a hybrid retrieval layer to catch exact terms, codes and internal jargon.
Add a semantic re-ranker such as the one in Azure AI Search to put the correct answer at the top, because the order of retrieved content drives answer quality.
Control the cost of precision with semantic caching and by reserving semantic ranking for ambiguous, high-value queries and critical content.
hook: Many Copilot and RAG projects stall because vector search returns similar but wrong content, and users stop trusting the answers. This episode is for architects who need enterprise-grade accuracy without an exploding Azure bill. It explains the hybrid search, re-ranking and semantic caching pattern that moves retrieval from 'close enough' to correct.
